QUESTIONS ABOUT OTHER WILKRIS PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

CategoriesQuestions About Wilkris CompanyQuestions About Wilkris Fluid Level Sensing GaugesQuestions About Fluid Filling SystemsQuestions About Other Wilkris Products and Services

Wilkris provides the following products and services:

Products

1. Digistick: A portable fluid level audit gauge.

2. Wilkris Fluid Level Gauge: for auditing and controlling industrial fluid filling applications.

3. Wilkris Top Roll gauge: for sugar cane milling processes.

4. Lasagna Reel: for photo developing processes.

Services

1. Consulting engineering services on a contractual basis.

2. Consulting engineering services for fluid filling and auditing projects.

3. Other engineering services including gauge reliability and repeatability (R&R) studies.

4. Maintenance contract services for Wilkris systems.
